name: Conventional manual compliance
description: Policies, evidence screenshots and periodic manual reviews prepared by staff with a readiness consultant
comparable_scope_note: Same SOC 1 + SOC 2 Type 2 scope and external pen test as all alternatives; fractional independent reviewer included for comparability

name: Commercial compliance platform
description: Subscription platform (evidence collection integrations, policy templates, auditor portal) plus internal administration
comparable_scope_note: Platform integrations cover generic cloud and identity evidence; financial and AI controls remain manual

name: Outsourced compliance management
description: vCISO / compliance-management retainer, usually bundled with a platform, plus internal support
comparable_scope_note: Retainer provides partial organizational independence; fractional reviewer cost reduced accordingly

name: Minimum viable Echelon assurance
description: Registers, validator, enforced release gates and evidence export on existing Echelon systems; most evidence still prepared manually
comparable_scope_note: Uses existing F# tooling and Praxis/Dokimos gates; no new systems

name: Targeted continuous automation
description: A4 plus continuous automation of high-frequency, high-risk controls (release gates, identity drift, evidence envelope, reconciliation, continuous security testing)
comparable_scope_note: Recommended direction; builds only where reuse across products and evidence frequency justify it

name: Hybrid: targeted automation + commercial platform
description: A5 prevention and testing automation, with a commercial platform for generic evidence collection and the auditor-facing workflow
comparable_scope_note: Lower integration build; platform evidence more commonly accepted by auditors (vendor claim, unverified)

name: Full internal assurance platform
description: Feature-parity internal compliance platform (evidence ledger, auditor portal, questionnaire engine, continuous monitoring across all controls)
comparable_scope_note: Not recommended without demonstrated demand; included for comparison
